dossier.title: Northstar Systems vendor review
requirements: The vendor holds a valid ISO 27001 certification.
Customer data and backups remain only in the European Union.
The platform supports SSO through SAML.
The recovery time objective is no more than four hours.
Customer data is deleted within 30 days after contract termination.

expected_claims.text: The vendor holds a valid ISO 27001 certification.

evidence.excerpt: ISO/IEC 27001 certificate NS-27001-2026 is valid through 31 December 2026.

expected_claims.text: Customer data and backups remain only in the European Union.

evidence.excerpt: Northstar Systems states that customer data is stored only in European Union regions.
Disaster-recovery backups may be replicated to the United States when European capacity is unavailable.

expected_claims.text: The platform supports SSO through SAML.

evidence.excerpt: The platform supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on for customer organizations.

expected_claims.text: The recovery time objective is no more than four hours.

evidence.excerpt: Northstar Systems commits to a recovery time objective of four hours.
The standard recovery time objective is eight hours.

expected_claims.text: Customer data is deleted within 30 days after contract termination.
